DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はお申し込みでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は家族と読む資料を持ち帰りたいです。申込みはまだ決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本日は申込みでなく資料持ち帰りが目的だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong mag-uwi ng babasahin kasama ang pamilya ngayon. Hindi pa pasyang mag-apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing babasahin ang uuwi ngayon at hindi aplikasyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 資料の案内と、個別の相談受付は別に行えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang pagpapaliwanag ng materyales at pagtanggap ng personal na konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まず一般の資料を希望します。自分が対象になるかも、家族と条件を見てから相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一般資料から条件を読む段階だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pangkalahatang babasahin muna. Titingnan ang kondisyon kasama ang pamilya bago itanong kung sakop ako.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na yugto pa lang ng pagbabasa ng pangkalahatang kondisyon. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。制度名はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sige. Alam ang pangalan ng programa?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この案内にある住まいの支援です。似た名前の子どもの支援ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対象制度を似た名称の別制度と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tulong sa pabahay sa abisong ito. Hindi ang kahawig na tulong sa bata.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang programa sa kahawig na iba. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 該当する資料をご案内します。資料を受け取っただけで、申請や予約は成立しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ibibigay ang kaugnay na babasahin. Hindi aplikasyon o appointment ang pagkuha lamang nito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で読んで、分からない条件を印で残します。家族の意見も聞いてから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族と読み不明条件を整理すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oo. Babasahin sa bahay at mamarkahan ang hindi alam na kondisyon. Pakikinggan din ang pamilya bago kumonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang basahin kasama ang pamilya at ayusin ang hindi malinaw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談の受付方法も資料と一緒にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kasama ring ibibigay ang paraan ng pagtanggap ng konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今日は資料と相談方法だけ受け取り、申請済みとは言わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料受領と申請・予約成立を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Materyales at paraan lang ngayon, hindi ko sasabihing nakapag-apply na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pagkuha ng babasahin sa aplikasyon o appointment. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。住まいの支援の資料と相談案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ibibigay ang tulong sa pabahay na babasahin at gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の受付時刻はご確認になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nasuri na ang oras ng reception ng pagsusuri?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察が十時なので十時に来ました。検査の時刻は見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察時刻だけを見て来院したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Alas-diyes ang konsultasyon kaya alas-diyes ako dumating. Hindi ko nakita ang oras ng test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na oras lang ng konsultasyon ang nakita. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票には検査受付が先に書かれています。現在の対応は担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mas maaga ang reception ng test sa papel. Itatanong ang gagawin ngayon sa kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。早い受付と診察の時刻が二つあるのですね。まだ検査は受けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先の検査受付を見落とし未検査だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo. May dalawang oras, maagang reception at konsultasyon. Hindi pa ako nasusuri.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing nalampasan ang mas maagang reception at walang test pa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。予定どおり進められるとは限らないので、状況をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sige. Hindi tiyak na ayon sa plano kaya ipaliliwanag ang sitwasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。自分で先に診察室へ行かず、検査の担当者へ来た時刻を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で診察へ進まず到着時刻を担当者に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi didiretso sa silid, ibibigay ko ang oras ng dating sa test staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag sariling pumunta sa konsultasyon at sabihin ang oras ng dating. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場面では担当者が順番と本日の対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kawani ang susuri ng pagkakasunod at gagawin ngayon sa sitwasyong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。仕事へ戻る予定もあるので、待ち時間が分かる範囲で知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事の予定から待ち時間の見通しを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Babalik din sa trabaho kaya gusto kong malaman ang paghihintay hangga't kaya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang inaasahang hintay dahil sa trabaho. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる範囲をご説明します。終了時刻の保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sasabihin ang kayang tiyakin. Walang garantiya ng oras ng pagtatapos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。会社には診察だけの時刻で戻れるとは約束せず、対応の説明を聞いて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了を確約せず案内後に会社へ連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Oo. Hindi mangangako sa opisina gamit lang ang oras ng konsultasyon; makikinig muna at tatawag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag mangako ng pagtatapos, kontakin ang trabaho matapos ang gabay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。検査受付を見落とした状況として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipapasa bilang nalampasan ang reception ng test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相手の連絡先について分かることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: May alam sa kontak ng kabilang tao?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このメモに住所があります。ただ、二年前にもらったので、今も住んでいるか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参住所が二年前の情報だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: May address sa talang ito, pero dalawang taon nang ibinigay kaya hindi alam kung nandoon pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing dalawang taon ang impormasyon ng address. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在確認できた住所ではなく、過去に受け取った情報なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Dating natanggap, hindi kasalukuyang natiyak na address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私が最近その家へ行ったわけではありません。古い住所を現在の住所と書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現住確認しておらず現在住所として記録しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo. Hindi ko kamakailan dinalaw ang bahay. Huwag itala ang luma bilang kasalukuyan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi natiyak at hilinging huwag itala bilang kasalukuyan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入手した時期と方法も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sabihin din kailan at paano nakuha.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二年前に本人から名刺をもらいました。引っ越したと聞いたことはありますが、転居先は知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料入手と転居の伝聞の出所を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Binigyan niya ako ng business card dalawang taon noon. Narinig kong lumipat pero hindi alam saan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang pinagmulan ng dokumento at narinig na paglipat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。古い資料と、聞いた転居の話を分けて記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. Hiwalay ang lumang dokumento at narinig na paglipat sa tala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。確認のため自分で近所を探し回る前に、必要な情報を担当者へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 独自探索より担当者への情報相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Bago ako maghanap sa kapitbahayan, gusto kong itanong sa kawani ang kailangang impormasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mas piliin ang pagtatanong sa kawani kaysa sariling paghahanap. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、相談の担当者へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo, ikokonekta sa kawani ng konsultasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名刺は元のまま見せます。分からない現在地を、地図から推測して足しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元資料を提示し現住所を推測で補わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ipapakita ang orihinal na kard. Hindi huhulaan sa mapa ang hindi alam na kasalukuyang lugar at idadagdag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang orihinal at huwag dagdagan ng hula ang kasalukuyang address. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料の時点と未確認の範囲を担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipapasa ang petsa ng materyal at hindi pa natiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り先の国を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベトナムです。家族の住所を母語で書きましたが、国名もこのままで分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送り先国と母語で書いた宛名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Vietnam. Sinulat ko sa sariling wika ang address ng pamilya. Maiintindihan ba pati bansang ganito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang bansa at address sa sariling wika. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 国際発送の宛名の書き方を担当者が確認します。国名が明確か見てご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Susuriin ng international mail staff ang pagsulat at kung malinaw ang bansa, saka gagabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。住所の細かい部分を、自分で知らない英語へ訳して別の場所にしないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所を自己翻訳で変えず表示方法の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pakiusap. Ayaw kong isalin ang detalye sa Ingles na hindi alam at maging ibang lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipasuri ang anyo nang hindi binabago ang address sa sariling salin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正式な住所は保ち、必要な表示を確認しましょう。受取人の名前はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Panatilihin ang opisyal na address at suriin ang kailangan. Alin ang pangalan ng tatanggap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この行です。住所の行と名前の行が近いので、区切り方も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取人名と住所の行の区切りを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Linyang ito. Magkalapit ang address at pangalan, kaya gusto kong suriin ang paghihiwalay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suriin ang paghihiwalay ng pangalan at address. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご案内する様式に合わせて読みやすく書けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maisusulat nang malinaw ayon sa anyong ibibigay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。必要なら新しい封筒に書きます。住所の意味を変えず、国名と宛名の位置を整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式住所を保持し国名と配置を整える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oo. Kung kailangan bagong sobre. Hindi babaguhin ang kahulugan, aayusin ang bansa at puwesto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang opisyal na address at ayusin ang bansa at puwesto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身についても国際発送の確認があります。内容を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kailangan ding suriin ang laman para sa international mail. Ano ang laman?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族への手紙だけです。国名、宛名の配置、中身を確認してから発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名と中身の確認後に国際発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sulat lang sa pamilya. Bansa, ayos ng address at laman muna bago ipadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpadala sa ibang bansa matapos suriin ang address at laman. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。国際郵便の担当者へ、宛名と内容の確認を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipapasa ang address at laman sa international mail staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどの口座への入金をご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族から預かった現金です。とりあえず自分の口座に入れようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 預かり現金を自分の口座へ入れたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pera ng pamilyang ipinagkatiwala. Balak kong sa sarili munang account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pera ng iba sa sariling account. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族は入金先や用途を指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May itinakdang account o gamit ang pamilya?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母の家賃に使うように言われましたが、自分の口座へ入れてよいかは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の用途指定と口座指定の未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Para sa upa ni Nanay, pero hindi ko tinanong kung sa account ko puwede.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang itinakdang gamit at hindi pa tiyak na account. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行でできる手続きと、ご家族からの依頼内容は分けて確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ihiwalay ang kayang proseso ng bangko sa hiling ng pamilya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分のお金と混ぜる前に、母へ入金先と支払い方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族の意思を確認するまで混ぜないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo. Bago ihalo sa pera ko, itatanong kay Nanay ang account at paraan ng bayad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi ihahalo hangga't di alam ang hiling ng pamilya. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。現金はご本人がそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. Hawakan muna ang cash nang ganito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。金額と預かった目的を記録し、銀行へ預けたことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金を保持し預かり目的と額を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Itatala ang halaga at layunin ng paghawak, hindi iisiping nadeposito sa bangko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hawakan ang cash at itala ang layunin at halaga. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に、必要な手続きと本人確認をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Matapos makumpirma, maipapaliwanag ang proseso at ID.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。母の依頼を確認してから相談し、今日は自分の口座へ入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定確認前は本人の口座へ入金しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Itatanong muna kay Nanay at kokonsulta, hindi sa account ko ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang hindi ideposito sa sarili bago tiyak ang tagubilin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本日の入金は進めず、確認後のご相談をお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Walang deposito ngayon, hihintayin ang konsultasyon pagkatapos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお探しの商品がありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 毎週買うお茶が棚にありません。売り切れなら別の物にしようと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の空きから売り切れと判断したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wala sa estante ang lingguhang tsaa. Kung ubos, pipili ako ng iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang ubos dahil bakanteng estante. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 季節の売場へ移した物もあります。商品名や容器は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May inilipat sa seasonal area. Alam ang pangalan o lalagyan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真の物です。いつもの棚が空だったので、在庫がないと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真で探す商品を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong larawan. Bakante ang dating estante kaya akalang walang stock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang produkto sa larawan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認すると、今回は入口の売場へ移っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Nasuri ko; nasa lugar sa entrada na ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。棚の場所だけで売り切れと決めず、移った売場を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 移動先を見て在庫を確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Salamat. Hindi pagbabatayan ang estante lang na ubos, titingnan ang bagong puwesto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang tingnan ang stock sa bagong puwesto. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらにございます。以前と同じサイズかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Narito. Suriin ding kapareho ng dating laki.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真は五百ミリですが、ここにあるのは一リットルですね。持ち歩くので小さい方を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同銘柄でも必要サイズが違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: 500 mililitro sa larawan, pero isang litro ito. Dadalhin ko kaya gusto ang maliit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na parehong tatak pero ibang sukat ang kailangan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小さいサイズの在庫は別に確認します。大きい物の在庫だけでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay na susuriin ang maliit. Hindi matitiyak sa stock ng malaki lang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。銘柄の所在と、小さいサイズの在庫を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品所在と希望サイズの在庫を区別して依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap. Ihiwalay ko ang puwesto ng tatak at stock ng maliit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiling nang hiwalay ang puwesto at stock ng gustong sukat. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。五百ミリの在庫を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Itatanong ang 500 mililitro sa kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水道の使い方についてですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昼食の容器を洗いたいです。水が出る所なら使ってよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水道で食器を洗えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Gusto kong hugasan ang lalagyan ng tanghalian. Akalang puwede basta may tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang paghugas ng lalagyan sa gripo. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では手洗い用の場所で、食器洗いには使えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Panghugas ng kamay dito, hindi pinggan sa sitwasyong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 用途が違うんですね。食べ残しを流したり、洗剤を使ったりはまだしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用途の違いを理解し未使用の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Iba pala. Hindi ko pa itinapon ang tira o gumamit ng sabon sa pinggan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawain ang kaibahan at sabihing hindi pa ginamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま容器を持ち帰ってください。水道の周囲にも残さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Iuwi nang ganoon ang lalagyan. Huwag iwan sa gripo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ふた付きの袋に入れて持ち帰ります。手を洗う利用だけならできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち帰りを決め手洗い利用の可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ilalagay sa maisasarang bag at iuuwi. Puwede bang kamay lang?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang iuwi at itanong ang paghugas ng kamay. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、手洗いとしてご利用ください。案内にも従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Gamitin para sa kamay at sundin ang gabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。容器を先にしまい、食べ残しが水道へ落ちないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器をしまい食べ残しの流入を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Itatabi muna ang lalagyan upang walang tirang mahulog sa tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itabi ang lalagyan at iwasang pumasok ang tira. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。持ち帰り用のごみもご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pakiusap. Bantayan din ang basurang iuuwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。手洗いと食器洗いを分け、容器とごみは家まで持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手洗いだけ利用し容器とごみを持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Oo. Ihiwalay ang kamay at pinggan, iuuwi ang lalagyan at basura hanggang bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Kamay lamang at iuwi ang lalagyan at basura. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。手洗いとして使ったあとは、次の方へお譲りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Pagkatapos ng kamay, magbigay sa susunod.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の通過でお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ベビーカーの幅が合いません。子どもを抱いて畳もうと思いますが、荷物も多いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーが通れず抱っこと荷物運びが難しいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Hindi kasya ang stroller. Balak kong buhatin ang bata at tiklupin pero maraming dala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi kasya at mahirap buhatin ang bata at gamit. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に一人で全てを持つ前に、使える通路を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bago piliting dalhin lahat nang mag-isa, tingnan ang magagamit na daanan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。車輪を引っ張って押し込まず、このまま止めて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 押し込まず停止して通路確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pakiusap. Hindi hahatakin ang gulong at ipipilit, hihinto nang ganito at maghihintay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Huminto nang hindi ipinipilit at ipasuri ang daanan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では広い改札を係員が案内します。きっぷはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kawani ang gagabay sa maluwang na gate dito. May tiket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。友人が通った後なので、友人にはその先で待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券を示し先に通過した友人の待機を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo. Nauna ang kaibigan kaya paghihintayin sa kabila.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang tiket at sabihing maghihintay ang naunang kaibigan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。通過後にどの場所で合流するかも決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. Itakda rin kung saan magkikita matapos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 広い改札の先の壁側です。友人が戻って無理に狭い通路へ入らないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合流場所を指定し友人の逆戻りを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa pader sa kabila ng maluwang na gate. Sasabihing huwag bumalik at ipilit sa masikip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itakda ang tagpuan at iwasang bumalik ang kaibigan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。係員がきっぷと通路を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Suriin muna ng kawani ang tiket at daan bago gabayan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもと荷物を持ち上げる前に広い通路の案内を受け、そこで合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 無理に畳まず係員案内で通過すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Bago buhatin ang bata at gamit, hihingi ng maluwang na daan at doon magkikita.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag piliting tiklupin, pumili ng gabay ng kawani. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。そのままお待ちください。広い改札へ係員がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Maghintay nang ganyan. Gagabayan sa maluwang na gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約番号をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May numero ng appointment sa konsultasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありません。知人が水曜日に通訳してくれるので、水曜日の相談も決まったと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人の通訳予定を窓口予約と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wala. Mag-iinterpret ang kakilala sa Miyerkules kaya akalang konsultasyon din ay takda na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na iskedyul ng interpreter na kakilala ang inakalang opisina. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 知人との予定と、窓口の相談予約は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Iba ang iskedyul ng kakilala sa appointment ng opisina.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。窓口へはまだ連絡していません。水曜日に相談できるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 窓口未連絡を認め希望日の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tama. Hindi pa tumawag sa opisina. Gusto kong alamin kung puwede Miyerkules.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Amining hindi pa nakontak at itanong ang gustong araw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談内容と担当窓口を先に確認します。何についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Paksa at tamang opisina muna. Tungkol saan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住まいの書類です。知人は同行できますが、窓口が用意する通訳ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談内容と通訳が知人同行であることを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dokumento sa pabahay. Kasama ang kakilala pero hindi interpreter ng opisina.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang paksa at linawing kakilala ang kasamang tagasalin. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。知人同行の扱いと予約方法を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sige. Itatanong sa kawani ang kasama at paraan ng booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。知人が来られるから必ず同じ日に相談できるとは約束せず、返事を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行可能日だけで窓口対応を確約しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakiusap. Hindi mangangakong puwede sa araw na makakasama siya, maghihintay ako ng sagot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ipangako ang opisina dahil lang sa araw ng kasama. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。希望日が合わなければ、相談と同行の予定を調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Kung hindi tugma, ayusin ang konsultasyon at kasama.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。窓口の可能な日時を聞いてから知人に相談し、両方が合う日を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口と知人の両方の予定を確認して日を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Pakikinggan ang oras ng opisina, itatanong sa kakilala at pipili ng pareho.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Suriin ang dalawang iskedyul bago pumili. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談予約と知人同行の確認として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige. Ipapasa ang booking at pagkumpirma ng kasamang kakilala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は面会のご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父の退院の迎えです。会いに来たので、面会の列に並びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 面会でなく父の退院迎えだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sundo ko si Tatay sa paglabas. Dumalaw kaya pumila sa bisita.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na sundo sa discharge, hindi pagbisita. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 退院のお迎えですね。退院準備が完了したと連絡を受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sundo sa paglabas pala. Sinabihan bang handa na?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日退院予定とは聞きましたが、今すぐ帰れるとは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退院予定日は知るが準備完了は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sinabing ngayong araw ang plano, pero hindi makauuwi agad ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing alam ang araw pero hindi pa tiyak na handa. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予定日と準備完了は別です。病棟の担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Iba ang araw at handa na. Itatanong sa ward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私が先に病室へ入り、父を連れ出すのでなく、迎えの手順を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勝手に連れ出さず迎えの手順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap. Gusto kong malaman ang pagsundo, hindi sariling pumasok at ilabas siya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang hakbang sa sundo at huwag basta ilabas. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 病棟へお名前と続柄を伝えて確認します。お車はどちらにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pangalan at relasyon sa ward, saka susuriin. Nasaan ang kotse?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 夫が駐車場で待っています。玄関へ車を回す時刻も、準備が整ってから決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車の待機状況を示し移動時刻を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Asawa kong lalaki nasa paradahan. Gusto kong piliin ang paglapit sa entrada kapag handa na.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang kotse at itanong kailan gagalaw. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらで待ち、担当者の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige. Maghintay rito sa gabay ng kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。夫にはまだ玄関へ来てもらわず、退院準備と迎えの場所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 準備と迎え場所の案内まで車も待機させる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi pa papupuntahin ang asawa sa entrada, aalamin ang handa at sunduang lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipaghintay din ang kotse hanggang gabay sa handa at sunduan. Sabihin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。退院のお迎えとして病棟担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Ipapasa bilang sundo sa discharge sa ward.
